newsitem.title: USA: US Diagnostic calls merger offer too low.
newsitem.headline: US Diagnostic calls merger offer too low.

text.p: US Diagnostic Inc on Thursday said a merger offer from Medical Resources Inc was too low and not of interest to the company.
"The highly conditional terms of the letter and the irresponsibly low proposed purchase price make the suggested combination of no interest to US Diagnostic Inc," the company said in a statement.
Earlier, Medical Resources said it was offering to buy the radiology services provider for $6.25 a share.
US Diagnostic shares closed down 3/8 at 5-1/2 in Nasdaq trading on Thursday. Medical Resources dipped 1/4 to 10-3/8.
US Diagnostic said it retained Smith Barney Inc for advice on possible financings, acquisitions, divestitures and other alternatives.
No decision has been made to sell the company nor is there any assurance that any transaction of any nature will take place, US Diagnostic said.
